question: If 1 is added to each even digit and 1 is subtracted from each odd digit in the number 937612548, then what will be the sum of all the odd digits in the new number thus formed?
solution:
Given Number- 937612548, 

1 is added to each even digit and 1 is subtracted from each odd digit in the number 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66ded4d05b8e71ff19107f9805791d5a859c2b9722655091582aa04fdfda3baf.png] 

The sum of all the odd digits in the new number = 7 + 3 + 5 + 9

= 24.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
